title: Invoice Correction Minimum for Missing-Information Corrections by Claim Size — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — invoice minimum, missing-information corrections (CO-16).** The billing-error corrections adjusted on the order's patient invoice count against a missing-information correction only once their total reaches the missing-information correction's invoice minimum. That minimum follows the amount the claim billed at filing:

| Amount the claim billed at filing | Invoice minimum |
|---|---|
| Below 250.00 USD (the small claim amount) | 1.00 USD (small-claim invoice minimum) |
| At least 250.00 USD but below 1000.00 USD (the mid claim amount) | 5.00 USD (mid-claim invoice minimum) |
| 1000.00 USD or more | 10.00 USD (standard invoice minimum) |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Billed at filing | Band | Invoice minimum |
|---|---|---|
| 249.99 | Below 250.00 | 1.00 |
| 250.00 | At least 250.00, below 1000.00 | 5.00 |
| 999.99 | At least 250.00, below 1000.00 | 5.00 |
| 1000.00 | 1000.00 or more | 10.00 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A claim billed 420.00 USD at filing; the order's invoice carries billing-error corrections of 4.00 USD. The invoice minimum is 5.00 USD, which 4.00 does not reach, so none of the corrections counts.
